Design.evidence_source: Within each pair of columns, results are split according to whether participants were randomly assigned to one of the conditions involving payoffs for themselves and another participant (i.e., the Self/Other, Self/Other–New, or Self/Other–Active condition) or one of the conditions involving payoffs for two other participants (i.e., the Other/Other, Other/Other–New, or Other/Other– Active condition).

country.evidence_source: No information about the country of study is provided in this section.

info_cost.evidence_source: No information about the cost to acquire information is provided in this section. Defaulting to 0.0 as per instructions.

Sample.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide total participant counts (N) for any condition, nor does it provide data for the control (full information) condition or dictator game choices.

N_Self_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide the number of selfish choices in the treatment conditions.

N_Self_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide any data for the control (full information) condition.

N_Altr_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide any data for the control (full information) condition, thus N_Altr_CI_Ctr cannot be derived.

N_Tot_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide total participant counts (N) for the treatment conditions.

N_Tot_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: Table 4 reports 'Fraction avoiding information in Hidden Information conditions' but does not provide any data for the control (full information) condition, including total participant counts (N).
